## SCN-026 — adr_create allocates ADR-NNN and adr_get returns it

**Kind:** `happy_path`
**Status:** `draft`
**Anchor:** `docs/system/capabilities/adr-system#0-as-implemented-2026-09-15`

### Preconditions

The project has an ADR table (migration applied).

### Steps

1. Call `adr_create` with a title
2. Call `adr_get` with the returned id

### Expected result

The id matches `ADR-NNN` and status is `proposed`.

### Notes

TSC-002. Claims match code as of 2026-09-15.

## SCN-027 — update() on an accepted ADR is refused
